sourceFile: 71. BRS-201506 CHECK GAUSS MG OF VENDER BAOTOU and RIUJIN RESULT (ME+PQC)_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but its changed-factor and outcome grouping is not reliable for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor merges supplier, dry process, size sheets, and Gauss Low vs Normal into one condition.
Baseline and test conditions are inconsistent across Baotou and Ruijin rows.
Several outcomes use header text as metrics instead of gauss or NG-rate metrics.
Measurement stats cite header rows and appear contaminated by line/sample indices.
Test C-MG Low gauss likely belongs to a separate comparison context.
correctionPlan: Split comparisons by sheet/test context and preserve supplier, process, date, line, and sample keys.
Define separate Baotou vs Ruijin and before/after dry process comparisons where rows support them.
Use NG Gauss Low, NG rate, and gauss values as outcomes with correct units.
Remove header-only or index-contaminated measurement outcomes.
Cite both header/context rows and exact data rows for each subresult.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row existence is sufficient, but citation relevance and row-level grouping are insufficient.
